title: We Will Rock You (Remastered 2011)

[00:17.61] You got mud on your face, you big disgrace

[00:54.00] We will, we will rock you
[00:59.51] Buddy, you're an old man, poor man
[01:01.72] Pleading with your eyes, gonna make you some peace someday
[01:05.00] You got mud on your face, big disgrace
[01:08.00] Somebody better put you back into your place
[01:11.30] We will, we will rock you (Sing it)
[01:17.50] We will, we will rock you (Everybody)
